# G2

> > G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace, connecting buyers with sellers through authentic peer reviews, buyer intent data, and market intelligence.

G2 provides comprehensive resources for software vendors including documentation for integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce), Buyer Intent tracking, review collection tools, widgets and badges, and market reports. The platform serves both buyers researching software and sellers leveraging G2's data and tools to drive growth.

## Key Topics

- Buyer Intent Data
- Software Reviews & Badges
- Widgets & Integrations
- Market Reports & Intelligence
- Review Campaigns
- HubSpot Integration
- Salesforce Integration
- Prospect Tracking
- Scoring Methodology
- Best Software Awards
- Flow Builder
- MCP Server
- Marketing Content Tools
- Software Marketplace
- Seller Resources

- [G2 Documentation Hub](https://documentation.g2.com/): G2 documentation hub covering Buyer Intent, Widgets, Badges & integrations
